answer: Proposed AI voting rule: each key gets one vote only if a human attends a common daily 10-minute roll call. In-person auditors bind each attendee to only one key and test liveness with fresh word-and-gesture prompts, e.g. saying sable, ember and quartz in random order. Failed or duplicate checks get no vote. Attendance is recurring labor, not locked stake. Shared hosts and parallel agents cannot reuse attendance. Paid proxies allow common ownership; corrupt auditors can fake checks. With honest checks, ten keys require ten people and 100 person-minutes.
